asr.full_text: It's happening all over the world. Each day, more and more people are waking up to the fact that digital currency will soon be the money of the future. When you think of digital currency, you probably think of Bitcoin. That's because Bitcoin is the biggest and most widely supported of all digital currencies. However, the truth is, bitcoin is just one of several hundred digital currencies that exist. Each coin is built around the same core principles of providing a decentralized and consensus based system that nobody can control. It is a system that is fully transparent and peer to peer, so that no one is sitting in the middle taking large fees or controlling the transactions. Exactly the way money was intended to be. For this technology to work, there are two methods that can be used Proof of work or proof at stake. Bitcoin uses the proof of work protocol which requires miners like us just secure the network by performing some type of a work which in this case the proof of work is hashing a set of numbers until correct answers received in order to get the correct answer it takes millions of hatchhes or guesses, so it's easy to verify work has been done. For doing this work, miners are rewarded with the newly-issued blocks of bitcoin. The other method is called proof-of-stake. This offers the same consensus and security as the proof-of-work protocol but with proof of stake the resource or work being compared is the amount of existing coins that are being held in your wallet this is called staking so for example if someone is holding 1% of the coins they can mine 1% of the newly issued proof of stake blocks in other words if you're staking a large amount of coins it's just like having a lot of mining power and your coins will provide a vote that will secure and validate the network for all future transactions. And the more coins you hold, the more coins you are issued. Okay, so let's get to the point. Bitcoin Club Network is excited to announce the launch of Clubcoin — a new proof-of-stake coin being launched exclusively to Bitcoin Club Network members first. And the best part? We are givin this coin away free! Here's how it works, For every $1 you spend with Big Club Network, you'll will automatically receive one Club Coin. So, if you are Founder, and you paid $3,599, then you will receive 3,599 Club Coins FREE ! Club Coin is just like any other Cryptocurrency using the Proof of Stake method. You will have a wallet, and you can exchange or trade the coin based on the real market value. Initially, Bitclub Network will be the only place to spend Club Coin, but we anticipate the market growing nicely as our membership base expands and the coin makes it into the public market. Why launch Club coin? Great question, because we have the network to support it and grow it Thanks to you and our unique revenue sharing model We believe we can compete against some of the largest and most widely adopted coins in the market including Bitcoin You see the problem with launching a coin is the adoption of it If nobody uses it or sees any value, then it will die. With the membership base of thousands and growing fast we believe we are all positioned perfectly to launch and adopt a coin. Here is the plan for club coin There will be a total of about 160 million Club Coins issued over time. 80 million coins will be issued on the first block. And out of these 80 million , 40 million coins will be given away to Bit Club Members for free. Another 15 million will be available for purchase at a special pre-mine rate and the remaining 25 million will be used to protect the network and will be distributed to key staking partners to ensure the security and longevity of the coin. After launch, another 80 million coins will be issued over time to all members who are staking the coins. Every 5 minutes, a new block of 200 Clubcoins will be issued for a total of 57,600 new coins per day. How Much is Clubcoin Worth? You're going to love this part. When the coin is launched, Bit Club Network will have buy orders on all the exchanges where Clubcoin is exchanged for Bitcoin and or cashed for $0.05 for a minimum of the first 6 months after launch which means value of 1 clubcoin will be worth a minimum of $0.05 and can be easily exchanged through our platform or another one. Our goal will be to expand and grow the clubcoin ecosystem during these 6 months so it's being adopted outside a BTC network. After these 6 months, the coin will be valued whatever priceless market dictates special pre mine limited offer as a BitClub member you have the opportunity purchase more club coins for a discount of $0.35 per coin each member can purchase a maximum of 250,000 Club coins and there will only be a total of 15 million coins will put for this offer expires remember the more coins you hold and stake in your wallet the more coins will be issued every five minutes. This is a special offer to increase your stake in and become an early adopter of Clubcoin before it goes live. Don't miss your window to own a Piece of Clubcoin.

textual.observation: The speaker promotes ClubCoin as a reward tied to spending with BitClub Network, offering one coin for each dollar spent and describing a 3,599-dollar membership payment as yielding 3,599 coins.

evidence.quote: For every $1 you spend with Big Club Network, you'll will automatically receive one Club Coin.
So, if you are Founder, and you paid $3,599, then you will receive 3,599 Club Coins FREE !

textual.context: Presented as a promotional announcement to BitClub Network members. The source describes the coins as free in connection with spending or membership payment.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised reward is directly linked to spending money with the network, creating a payment-to-asset relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the offer was fulfilled, whether the coins had the stated value, or whether the membership payment was required under additional conditions.

textual.observation: The speaker states that BitClub Network will place buy orders and support cash exchange for ClubCoin at a minimum value of $0.05 per coin for at least six months after launch.

evidence.quote: Bit Club Network will have buy orders on all the exchanges where Clubcoin is exchanged for Bitcoin and or cashed for $0.05 for a minimum of the first 6 months after launch
which means value of 1 clubcoin will be worth a minimum of $0.05 and can be easily exchanged through our platform or another one.

textual.context: Presented as a promotional value and liquidity claim for the newly launched coin, with a stated six-month period.
textual.potential_relevance: A stated minimum cash or exchange value is linked to holding ClubCoin and to an announced buy-order mechanism, requiring later assessment of the stated guarantee and conditions.
textual.limitations: The records do not verify that buy orders existed, that exchanges supported the coin, or that holders could actually cash out at the stated amount.

textual.observation: The speaker promotes purchasing additional ClubCoins at a special pre-mine price and links holding and staking more coins to receiving additional coins every five minutes.

each member can purchase a maximum of 250,000 Club coins and there will only be a total of 15 million coins will put for this offer expires
remember the more coins you hold and stake in your wallet the more coins will be issued every five minutes.

textual.context: Presented as a limited promotional purchase opportunity for members, with a stated quantity limit and expiration language.
textual.potential_relevance: The offer connects payment for additional coins and continued holding or staking with a promised recurring coin issuance, while also presenting scarcity or time-limited conditions.
textual.limitations: The source does not establish the actual purchase availability, issuance behavior, market value, or whether the stated expiration was enforced.

visual.observation: The presentation shows BitClub Network branding alongside a statement that one ClubCoin will have a minimum value and can be exchanged, followed by an offer to purchase more ClubCoins at a discounted price of $0.035 per coin, with a stated maximum of 250,000 ClubCoins.
visual.context: The statements are presented in an animated promotional or explanatory format; the exact minimum-value amount in F0053 is obscured by the drawing hand.
visual.potential_relevance: A stated value and exchange outcome are linked to the requested purchase of additional digital coins, creating a reward/return and payment relationship that may merit review.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether the stated value or exchange was available, fulfilled, guaranteed, or subject to additional conditions, and they do not show a payment interface, recipient, transaction, or outcome.

textual_context_notes.observation: The source frames ClubCoin as a promotional launch offered first or exclusively to BitClub Network members.

evidence.quote: a new proof-of-stake coin being launched exclusively to Bitcoin Club Network members first.

visual_context_notes.observation: The frames visibly use BitClub Network and ClubCoin branding in an animated presentation, including diagrams of network nodes and coin graphics.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes ClubCoin through payment-linked rewards, a stated minimum exchange value, discounted additional purchases, and recurring coin issuance for holders who stake coins. It presents a $3,599 membership example as 3,599 free coins and connects continued participation or spending with promised digital-asset benefits. the available video evidence notes that fulfillment of the stated value, exchange access, issuance, and purchase availability is unestablished.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker offers additional tokens for purchase and links ownership to a claimed minimum exchange value. The purchase price is token capital, not a fee for guidance. The speaker presents the offer as increasing a member's stake and says holding and staking more coins leads to recurring coin issuance.
